company_name: Sandisk India Device Design Centre Private Limited
semiconductor_relevance: High — Sandisk is a leading global semiconductor memory company specializing in NAND flash technology.
summary: Sandisk India Device Design Centre focuses on designing and producing semiconductor memory technologies that enable data storage and access across various applications, including consumer devices and cloud infrastructure. regional_presence.India: Sandisk has a significant design presence in India, contributing to its global semiconductor memory solutions.
